init.title: Set up work area and claim the lease
init.imperative: Run: py C:/Users/fredc/AppData/Local/Temp/constellation-eval-jze6u34f/skills/constellation-explorer/scripts/init_work_area.py <work-id> --spine C:/Users/fredc/AppData/Local/Temp/constellation-eval-jze6u34f/skills/constellation-explorer/templates/EXPLORER_SPINE.template.json --skill-dir C:/Users/fredc/AppData/Local/Temp/constellation-eval-jze6u34f/skills/constellation-explorer to scaffold .agent-work/<work-id>/ and materialize spine.json with its placeholders resolved (do not hand-substitute). Then claim the engine session lease so a resumed or duplicated session cannot concurrently drive this spine: <engine> claim --session-id <work-id> --claimed-by explorer --worktree . (if a stale prior lease blocks you, re-run with --force --reason "resuming this run"). From here on pass --session-id <work-id> on every mutating engine call against this spine. Explorer is upstream-only and human-synchronous: it has NO delegated/autonomous mode, and convergence decisions belong to the human alone.

postconditions.statement: work area scaffolded and spine.json materialized
engine session lease claimed for this spine (explorer owns the state)

context.title: Load baseline context and seed the ideas board
context.imperative: Read your inherited global doctrine (this skill's references/global-orchestrator.md and references/global-everyone.md, including the deep-module vocabulary), then the project deltas (docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT.md, GLOSSARY.md where they exist) and the current map for the area the idea touches, where architecture artifacts exist. Seed .agent-work/<work-id>/IDEAS_BOARD.md from templates/IDEAS_BOARD.template.md: the living record of shared understanding (the point; current candidates; verdicts with the scope of what was tested; open threads; rejected ideas with reasons; cycle log). Every consolidation updates it; the spec crystallizes from it; a resumed session reads it instead of chat history. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: doctrine + project deltas + map read where they exist; IDEAS_BOARD.md seeded from template

explore.title: Run exploration cycles until the human converges or shelves
explore.imperative: Run repeatable exploration cycles; this step stays in-progress across cycles. Each cycle is its own survey (cycle-<N>.json in the work-area root, from templates/CYCLE.template.json), driven with constellation-interrogator doctrine loaded (one question at a time, recommended answers, code-answers-over-questions). At cycle start the human picks a flavor (shotgun | compare | refine; the agent may recommend). Run point-questions, then dispatch excursions as BACKGROUND subagents via py C:/Users/fredc/AppData/Local/Temp/constellation-eval-jze6u34f/skills/constellation-explorer/scripts/run_crew.py (durable registry); run py C:/Users/fredc/AppData/Local/Temp/constellation-eval-jze6u34f/skills/constellation-explorer/scripts/recover_crews.py <work-id> before EACH dispatch and before consolidation so an in-flight excursion is never lost to a crash. Every excursion answers one named question and obeys scoped-nulls doctrine (a failed excursion kills THAT test under those conditions, never the idea class). Consolidate: cluster and cull ideas (culls stay on the board with reasons), fold in excursion findings, update IDEAS_BOARD.md. PREMATURE CONVERGENCE IS THE FAILURE MODE THIS STEP EXISTS TO PREVENT: never initiate convergence. Present each cycle's consolidated ideas and open threads; only the human says 'converge to spec' or 'shelve'. You may flag ripeness only as a standalone message containing nothing else. Record the human's converge/shelve decision as a user-decision evidence artifact (attach explore --type user-decision --field decision=...). This step closes ONLY on that decision AND the verify_cycles.py check: at least one cycle-*.json exists and every one carries a non-null consolidation — explore cannot close having run zero cycles or with an unconsolidated cycle.

preconditions.statement: baseline context loaded and ideas board seeded

postconditions.statement: human recorded a converge/shelve decision (convergence is the human's alone)
at least one consolidated exploration cycle exists in the work area

spec.title: Crystallize the design spec from the board
spec.imperative: Crystallize .agent-work/<work-id>/DESIGN_SPEC.md from the ideas board using templates/DESIGN_SPEC.template.md. It ships with the loud 'UNCONFIRMED — DO NOT CUT' marker and a DRAFT Confirmation block — that is deliberate: verify_spec_confirmed.py refuses it until the confirm gate is genuinely met. Present the design for per-section approval (delta-based after the first pass: present what changed since the last confirmation, not the whole statement again). Run design-it-twice on EVERY load-bearing interface (3+ parallel agents each designing the same module's interface under a distinct constraint — minimal-interface / max-flexibility / common-caller-first / ports-and-adapters — compared on depth, locality, seam placement, testability; opinionated recommendation or hybrid); skip a trivial interface only with a stated reason. Describe interfaces in deep-module terms. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: DESIGN_SPEC.md crystallized from the board with per-section approval; load-bearing interfaces designed-it-twice or skipped with a stated reason

review.title: Cold adversarial critical review
review.imperative: Dispatch a cold, full-adversary critic via templates/CRITIC_HANDOFF.template.md: the critic reads the spec with NO exploration record, nothing sacred, and may attack deliberate decisions; the human filters relitigation noise. Panel scaled by weight — default one critic; a spec that would spawn epics or touch architecture gets a 3-lens panel (intent-fit / testability / simplicity-YAGNI). When in doubt, panel. Every finding lands in the spec's structured findings table (fixed columns 'ID | Lens | Severity | Finding | Disposition | Reason'; Disposition in EDIT / RE-EXPLORE / REJECT) and the human triages each one. A RE-EXPLORE disposition is an engine reopen of the explore step: the inline rework cap is 99 so the critic->re-explore loop never hard-blocks, and the reopen cascade resets spec/review/confirm and supersedes their evidence — survivable because the ideas board is the source of truth and the spec re-crystallizes from it. This step closes only when every Disposition cell is filled, checked mechanically by verify_spec_confirmed.py --phase review.

postconditions.statement: critic findings table present with no empty Disposition cell

confirm.title: Hard confirmation gate
confirm.imperative: The hard gate: no work is cut from an unconfirmed design. Fill the spec's Confirmation block — Status CONFIRMED, Confirmed by, Date — and record assumptions exercised vs accepted untested (accepting an untested load-bearing assumption is a visible, human-signed choice, never a silent skip). Get the human's explicit confirmation and record it as a user-decision evidence artifact (attach confirm --type user-decision --field decision=confirmed). Trust model, stated honestly: the engine records a user-decision rather than cryptographically proving a human made it; explorer has no delegated mode, so fabricating one violates doctrine an agent has no sanctioned path around — verify_spec_confirmed.py and the downstream UNCONFIRMED refusal are the mechanical backstops. This step closes on the user-decision artifact AND verify_spec_confirmed.py (Confirmation block filled: Status CONFIRMED with confirmer and date, and no empty Disposition cell).

postconditions.statement: human recorded an explicit confirmation decision
Confirmation block filled and no empty Disposition cell (verifier passes)

route.title: Route the confirmed spec, archive, release
route.imperative: The human routes the confirmed spec — explorer NEVER cuts issues itself (to-issues owns cutting): (a) hand off to constellation-to-issues or directly to a Commander; (b) file one 'shaped design' issue holding the full spec body; or (c) shelve unconfirmed — file the ideas board as the shaped-design issue carrying a loud `UNCONFIRMED — DO NOT CUT` header so nothing downstream cuts it. Then archive the work area (move .agent-work/<work-id>/ to .agent-work/archive/<date>-<work-id>/) and release the engine session lease on this spine: <engine> release --session-id <work-id>. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: confirmed spec routed (handed off / shaped-design issue filed / shelved with UNCONFIRMED header); work area archived; engine lease released
